Description: User can create an account and log in to the travel app
User can explore a map-like interface of travel locations around the world
User can place an experience they have had as a marker on the map
User can attach one or more pictures to an experience
User can rate an experience out of 5 stars
User can add personal notes to an experience
User can view the details of a selected experience including pictures, rating, and notes
User can edit an existing experience on the map
User can delete an experience from the map
System stores each user's experiences, pictures, ratings, and notes persistently
User can filter or search their experiences by location or rating
User can log out of the travel app
User can update their account profile information
User can send and accept friend requests
User can add friends and see which friends are connected to their account
User can view experiences shared by friends on the map
User can comment on a friend's shared experience
